hints.text: The $15$ is only a piece of the mystery number. What fraction of the whole is $25\%$, and how many such pieces make the whole?
$25\%$ is one quarter, so $15$ is one of $4$ equal pieces. The whole number is $4$ of those pieces: work out $15 \times 4$.
Four pieces of $15$ make $15 \times 4 = 60$, so the number is $60$.

explanation: $25\%$ equals $\frac{1}{4}$, so $15$ is one quarter of the unknown number.
Four quarters make the whole, so multiply the quarter by $4$: $15 \times 4 = 60$.
Check by going forward: one quarter of $60$ is $60 \div 4 = 15$, which matches.
The number we were looking for is $60$.
